g.text: CLASSIC 8-CUP (1.0 L / 34 FL. OZ.) • STANDARD THREE-PIECE PLUNGER FILTER SYSTEM

text.tspan: Ergonomic spherical dome knob; screws or press-fits
Solid 18/8 stainless steel shaft with threaded bottom
Double-wall cover with integrated splash flange
Perforated upper disc with perimeter helical tension
coil that exerts dynamic radial force against glass carafe.
80-mesh woven stainless steel wire cloth with stamped
center grommet; traps grounds while extracting coffee oils.
Rigid 4-arm support base with threaded female hub
(M5); locks the entire filter stack onto the plunger shaft.
with precision drip-free spout and metric volume graduations.
Stainless steel protective chassis with collar straps
and elevated arched feet that isolate heat from surfaces.
Ergonomic stay-cool handle with dual-bracket collar

g.text: Assembly order: [04] Spiral Plate → [05] Mesh Screen → [06] Cross Plate
• Spiral spring provides circumferential tension, pressing the fine mesh tightly against glass walls.
• Rigid threaded cross plate anchors sandwich stack securely to plunger rod with zero blow-by.
• Standard 3-piece filter allows full disassembly for hygienic cleaning and screen replacement.
